display_name: Snapdeal formula pattern — Return Rate by Category
formula_sql:
SELECT
  product_category,
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
  COUNT_IF(transaction_type = 'reverse') AS returns,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT_IF(transaction_type = 'reverse') / COUNT(*), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.snapdeal_oms
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY product_category
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC;
